WITH store_attainment AS (
    SELECT
        s.StoreKey,
        ds.StoreName,
        sum(s.actual_sales) AS actual_sales,
        sum(q.sales_quota) AS sales_amount_quota,
        sum(s.actual_sales) / nullIf(sum(q.sales_quota), 0) AS quota_attainment
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ) AS s
    INNER JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS sales_quota
        FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ) AS q
        ON s.StoreKey = q.StoreKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS ds
        ON s.StoreKey = ds.StoreKey
    GROUP BY
        s.StoreKey,
        ds.StoreName
)
SELECT
    performer_group,
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    actual_sales,
    sales_amount_quota,
    quota_attainment
FROM
(
    SELECT
        'top_5' AS performer_group,
        StoreKey,
        StoreName,
        actual_sales,
        sales_amount_quota,
        quota_attainment
    FROM store_attainment
    ORDER BY quota_attainment DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
UNION ALL
SELECT
    performer_group,
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    actual_sales,
    sales_amount_quota,
    quota_attainment
FROM
(
    SELECT
        'bottom_5' AS performer_group,
        StoreKey,
        StoreName,
        actual_sales,
        sales_amount_quota,
        quota_attainment
    FROM store_attainment
    ORDER BY quota_attainment ASC
    LIMIT 5
)
ORDER BY performer_group, quota_attainment DESC;
